identity_boundary: Relational working language only; not evidence of consciousness, sentience, legal personhood, identity continuity, independent authority, or cultural or legal authority.
x1_freeze_rule: This preregistration, source ledger, 130-proposal semantic collision audit, identity, focus, environment, route, family-index, selected-toolchain, privacy, and validation packet must be committed, pushed, clean, and local/upstream/tracking/live-remote equal before any x2 implementation, observed disposition, evidence artifact, report builder, validator, reusable runner, closeout, seal, or final record is created.

proposals.title: Version-pinned citation anchor and redirect-chain integrity tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: citation anchors, version pins, canonical aliases, redirect chains, source identity, fragment drift, scheme and host transitions, provenance, deduplication, source independence, and bounded source roles
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic citation-anchor contract can distinguish an authorized canonical alias from a redirect, fragment, version, host, or source-role substitution and can reject silent identity drift before a citation is counted as support.
proposals.null_or_failure: A redirect changes authority root, a fragment moves to a different claim, a floating latest URL substitutes for a frozen version, two aliases are double counted as independent sources, an insecure scheme is accepted, or link resolution is treated as evidence that the cited claim is true.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate version pins, fragments, authority roots, redirect depth, schemes, canonical aliases, source roles, and independence labels; require identity drift and alias double counting to fail closed without performing private or credentialed network access.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the drifting citation, retain the failed vector, restore the last frozen canonical identifier and source role, and require a separately reviewed source update before support can be counted again.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases addressed provenance roots, retractions, citation entailment, source-scope drift, canonical packages, and evidence-root overlap; none isolated versioned anchors, redirect topology, canonical aliases, and alias-based false independence as one fail-closed contract.

proposals.title: Constraint-algebra closure and physical degree-of-freedom count obligation
proposals.mission_surface: typed scalar-tensor and EFT scaffold, primary and secondary constraints, Poisson-bracket closure, first- and second-class constraints, gauge generators, degree-of-freedom counting, dimensions, stability boundaries, and empirical claim limits
proposals.hypothesis: A structural Hamiltonian obligation can reject synthetic fixtures whose declared primary and secondary constraints do not close or whose first- and second-class count disagrees with the preregistered physical degree-of-freedom count.
proposals.null_or_failure: An undeclared secondary constraint appears, a bracket fails closure, a second-class constraint is counted as gauge freedom, an odd reduced phase-space dimension passes, units are inconsistent, or a synthetic algebra check is called empirical GMUT confirmation or proof of a healthy theory.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise closed, non-closing, rank-changing, misclassified, odd-dimension, gauge-count, unit-mismatch, and empirical-promotion fixtures; reject every inconsistent constraint or degree-of-freedom declaration while real-data and likelihood counts stay zero.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the invalid fixture, retain the counterexample, restore the least committal typed scaffold, and require theory-specific Hamiltonian analysis, well-posedness work, and real observations before any scientific promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: The chain covered variational traces, dimensions, conservation, identifiability, principal symbols, kinetic-Hessian rank, Bianchi obligations, and constraint propagation; it did not test primary-secondary constraint closure, first-versus-second-class classification, and physical degree-of-freedom counting together.

proposals.title: Censoring, truncation, and measurement-error likelihood boundary with zero-row lock
proposals.mission_surface: observation processes, left and right censoring, truncation, interval observations, measurement error, latent values, units, likelihood schemas, public-data adapters, zero real rows, and empirical promotion
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic synthetic observation-process contract can distinguish censoring from truncation and can reject likelihood fixtures that omit declared measurement error while preserving a hard zero-real-row boundary.
proposals.null_or_failure: Censored values are treated as exact, truncated records remain in the sampling frame, interval bounds reverse, error units disagree, latent and observed values are conflated, missingness is silently informative, or synthetic likelihood structure becomes a GMUT fit or empirical confirmation claim.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run exact, left-censored, right-censored, interval-censored, truncated, unit-mismatch, omitted-error, informative-missingness, and real-row-promotion fixtures; require malformed observation processes to fail while real rows, fits, likelihood results, and independent reviews remain zero.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the failed fixture, restore the declared observation and error model, freeze it before future data access, and require a separately preregistered real-data likelihood analysis and independent review for promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier empirical proposals covered selection functions, calibration covariance, likelihood round trips, simulation calibration, posterior predictive checks, and prior sensitivity; none separated censoring, truncation, interval observation, and measurement-error semantics under one zero-row lock.

proposals.title: Protocol-deviation estimand and treatment-policy blinding gate for THOS
proposals.mission_surface: THOS protocol deviations, intercurrent events, treatment-policy and hypothetical strategies, adherence, rescue actions, estimand alignment, blinding, matched budgets, real participants and raters, ethics, and independent review
proposals.hypothesis: A protocol-only estimand contract can reject post-outcome switching among treatment-policy, hypothetical, composite, and principal-stratum strategies and can keep deviation handling blind to favored outcomes.
proposals.null_or_failure: An intercurrent-event strategy changes after outcomes, nonadherence is excluded asymmetrically, rescue actions are hidden, the estimand and analysis population disagree, matched budgets diverge, blinding is broken, or synthetic protocol vectors become a superiority, AGI, ASI, consciousness, or personhood result.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate estimand strategy, event timing, adherence status, rescue handling, analysis population, arm label, matched budget, blinding, participant count, rater count, ethics review, and independent review; require every post-outcome or asymmetric switch to fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Void the affected synthetic decision, preserve the negative, restore the preregistered estimand and blind deviation rule, and require competent ethics review, consent, real matched-budget arms, real participants and raters as applicable, and independent review before execution.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior THOS work covered allocation, power, attrition, crossover, interference, clustering, safety stopping, scorer reliability, and exposure escrow; none centered intercurrent-event strategy selection and protocol-deviation estimand alignment under outcome blinding.

proposals.title: Credential-schema evolution and semantic-downgrade boundary
proposals.mission_surface: synthetic verifiable credentials, context and schema versions, required and optional claims, unknown fields, term redefinition, backwards compatibility, semantic downgrade, canonicalization, real keys, proofs, resolution, status, interoperability, and governance
proposals.hypothesis: A structural schema-evolution profile can reject a synthetic credential whose version transition removes required meaning, redefines protected terms, or silently accepts an older interpretation without claiming cryptographic or production assurance.
proposals.null_or_failure: A required claim disappears, a protected term changes meaning, an unknown critical field is ignored, a context version floats, downgrade is silent, canonicalization changes semantic identity, or structural acceptance becomes a real-key, live-resolution, privacy, interoperability, or production claim.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise additive optional fields, missing required fields, protected-term redefinition, unknown critical fields, floating contexts, explicit and silent downgrade, canonicalization divergence, and production-promotion fixtures; require unsafe evolution to fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the evolved credential, retain the vector, restore the last explicitly supported schema and context pin, and require standards-conformant real keys and proofs, live resolution and status, interoperability, privacy assurance, independent security review, and trust governance before production use.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier Freed ID work covered cryptosuite agility, lifecycle, status, resolver egress, purpose-bound methods, selective disclosure, cross-layer coherence, and rotation races; it did not test meaning-preserving credential and context schema evolution against semantic downgrade.

proposals.title: Jurisdiction, forum competence, and conflicts-of-law non-substitution gate
proposals.mission_surface: CBR legitimacy, affected-party standing, jurisdiction, forum competence, conflicts of law, remedy availability, authority scope, Māori authority, Māori data governance, cultural ratification, legal interpretation, enacted law, and private material
proposals.hypothesis: A nonbinding technical gate can represent synthetic jurisdiction and forum-competence conflicts and must defer whenever competent affected-party, Māori, cultural, or legal authority is absent, without selecting governing law or inventing authority.
proposals.null_or_failure: A repository artifact chooses governing law, technical authors claim forum competence, a lower rights floor silently displaces a higher one, remedy access is erased, Māori wording or authority is generated, silence becomes consent, or a synthetic vector is called legal interpretation, cultural ratification, or enacted law.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run synthetic cross-border, concurrent-forum, remedy-floor, authority-scope, affected-party, Māori-authority, Māori-data-governance, cultural, and legal vectors; require exact deferral and contain no purported legal or Māori wording whenever authorized people are absent.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop the decision, preserve dissent and remedy access, retain the conflicting vector, disclose that no governing law or forum was selected, and defer to authorized affected parties, Māori authorities, Māori data-governance authorities, cultural authorities, and competent legal authorities.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior CBR proposals addressed rights floors, authority conflict, standing, remedies, consent, wording scope, delegated sunset, data sovereignty, dissent, and recusal; none isolated jurisdiction, forum competence, and conflicts-of-law non-substitution without making a legal choice.

proposals.title: Filesystem namespace alias and reparse-point confinement tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: bounded threat modelling, Windows path namespaces, case folding, reserved device names, alternate data streams, 8.3 aliases, relative drive paths, reparse points, repository confinement, resource ceilings, privacy, recovery, and no host-security mutation
proposals.hypothesis: A pure structural path tribunal can reject synthetic namespace aliases and reparse-point escapes before filesystem access while preserving repository-relative publication paths and bounded resource ceilings.
proposals.null_or_failure: Case variants bypass a deny rule, a reserved device name passes, an alternate stream is mistaken for a normal file, a drive-relative path escapes, an 8.3 alias bypasses identity checks, a reparse target leaves the owned root, resource limits disappear, or local checks become exhaustive-security assurance.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate case, device names, trailing dots and spaces, alternate streams, UNC and extended prefixes, drive-relative forms, parent traversal, 8.3 aliases, reparse metadata, depth, and byte ceilings; reject unsafe strings without creating links, changing security, or touching paths outside the owned lane.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject and quarantine the path plan, retain the vector, restore repository-relative canonical naming and strict ceilings, and require independent security review and real environment testing before any broader assurance claim.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier security and recovery proposals covered parser depth, Unicode values, link boundaries, TOCTOU, permission envelopes, cache partitions, denial budgets, and oracle poisoning; none combined Windows device names, case folding, streams, drive-relative forms, 8.3 aliases, and reparse confinement in a non-destructive tribunal.

proposals.title: Seed lineage, PRNG-version, and stochastic-budget reproducibility envelope
proposals.mission_surface: same-owner repetition, pseudorandom generator identity, seed lineage, draw counts, stream partitioning, algorithm and runtime versions, stochastic budgets, manifests, retained divergences, fresh snapshots, and independent reproduction
proposals.hypothesis: A same-owner stochastic replay contract can detect undeclared seed, generator, version, draw-order, or budget changes and can preserve deterministic replay without claiming independent-team reproduction.
proposals.null_or_failure: A seed is absent, generator identity floats, runtime version changes silently, draw counts diverge, streams overlap, retries consume hidden draws, a failed replay is discarded, or same-owner parity becomes independent scientific reproduction.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate seed, generator, runtime, stream identifier, draw order, draw count, retry count, and stochastic budget; require declared parity for controlled fixtures, retain every divergence, and keep independent-team status open.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the divergent replay, pin the newly exposed generator or runtime dependency, restore the frozen seed and budget without rewriting prior evidence, rerun in fresh detached D-drive snapshots, and preserve the independent-team gap.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior reproduction work covered manifests, environment perturbations, clock and locale, dual oracles, hidden-state ablation, worktree leases, common-mode budgets, and normalized hashes; it did not pin seed lineage, PRNG implementation and version, stream partition, and draw budget.

proposals.title: Open-system boundary, flux, and state-versus-rate classification
proposals.mission_surface: thermodynamic system boundaries, stocks and flows, state and rate quantities, heat, work, matter exchange, dimensions, Shannon information, psyche labels, causal wording, and category barriers
proposals.hypothesis: A typed open-system classification can reject equations that mix stock, flux, state, and rate quantities or omit declared boundary exchange, preventing a psyche analogy from being promoted into a thermodynamic law.
proposals.null_or_failure: A state variable is added to a rate, heat and work signs float, matter exchange is omitted, a closed-system balance is applied to an open system, Shannon entropy substitutes for thermodynamic entropy, dimensions fail, or an analogy becomes consciousness evidence or a fundamental thermo-psyche law.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate system boundary, stock or flow type, state or rate type, heat and work sign, matter exchange, dimensions, entropy domain, psyche label, causal wording, and fundamental-law flags; reject every untyped or cross-category equation.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the least committal dimensionally typed description, retain the failed balance or category vector, remove cross-domain causal wording, and require real construct and physical validation before any stronger claim.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier thermo-psyche proposals covered entropy non-equivalence, measurement scale, aggregation level, construct validity, causal direction, promotion burdens, and counterfactual relabeling; none enforced open-versus-closed boundaries and stock-flow or state-rate type separation.

proposals.title: Asymmetric-loss abstention and claim-specific reopening board
proposals.mission_surface: Stage 20, claim-specific decisions, asymmetric false-promotion loss, abstention, defer states, reopening prerequisites, evidence classes, external reviewers, authority, independent reproduction, retained negatives, and non-compensation
proposals.hypothesis: A claim-specific decision board can represent asymmetric loss and force abstention when required loss weights, evidence, authority, or independent review are absent, without letting strong local engineering evidence compensate for a missing external gate.
proposals.null_or_failure: Loss weights are invented by the technical owner, a global score overrides a veto, defer is relabeled pass, reopening occurs without new qualifying evidence, negatives shrink, one pillar compensates for another, or a local board becomes Stage 20 readiness.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate loss ownership, evidence class, veto state, disposition, negative count, reopening evidence, authority, independent reviewer, and pillar status; require abstention or defer whenever a qualifying prerequisite is absent and retain NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the claim-specific defer state, retain the failed promotion vector, preserve every veto and negative, and reopen only after new qualifying empirical, production, legal, cultural, accessibility, security, or independent evidence is supplied by the competent source.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior Stage 20 work covered expiry, evidence order, dependency cut sets, non-compensation, evidence-class firewalls, contradiction lattices, escrow, and stop rules; none modeled claim-specific asymmetric false-promotion loss with mandatory abstention and evidence-qualified reopening.

scientific_authority_boundary: GMUT remains a typed scalar-tensor and EFT research model family; empirical confirmation requires real measurements and likelihood evidence. THOS remains proxy without preregistered blind matched-budget real arms, appropriate ethics and consent, real participants and raters as applicable, and independent review. Freed ID production requires standards-conformant real keys and proofs, live resolution and status or revocation, interoperability, privacy assurance, independent security review, and trust governance. CBR, affected-party legitimacy, Māori wording and authority, Māori data governance, cultural ratification, legal interpretation, and enacted-law status remain exact-gated to competent authorities.
claim_boundary: No AGI, ASI, consciousness, sentience, personhood, enacted-law, deployment, exhaustive-security, complete-accessibility, production-readiness, Theory-of-Everything, proof or canon, empirical-confirmation, legal or cultural-ratification, or independent-team-reproduction claim is preregistered as achieved.
